dialogues.jp: 朝日がまぶしくて寝返りを打つ。
dialogues.en: I roll over in my sleep to avoid the morning sun.
dialogues.text: I roll over in my sleep to avoid the morning sun.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ♪」

柔らかくて暖かい抱き枕に腕が触れた。それを
引き寄せる前に、勝手に枕が抱きついてくる。
dialogues.en:
My soft, warm, huggable pillow seems to have an arm. Before
I pull it towards me, the pillow comes and hugs me by
itself.
dialogues.text:
My soft, warm, huggable pillow seems to have an arm. Before
I pull it towards me, the pillow comes and hugs me by
itself.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゅうにゅ」

なにか、ふさふさとした塊がのしかかってくる
ので、無意識に押し返す。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃはは……くすぐったい」
dialogues.en:
"Uhh, come on! Stop doing that in the morning. But if you
want it..."
dialogues.text:
"Uhh, come on! Stop doing that in the morning. But if you
want it..."

dialogues.jp:
手触りはふにゃふにゃしていて良いのだが、睡
眠を邪魔されては、どのみち鬱陶しさに違いは
無い。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あにゃ……ダメだよ朝からそんな……でも、
　お兄ちゃんが望むのならボク……」
dialogues.en:
At first I thought I was dreaming, because the ceiling and
the smell of the tatami mat were totally unfamiliar.
dialogues.text:
At first I thought I was dreaming, because the ceiling and
the smell of the tatami mat were totally unfamiliar.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Whoa, it sounds like a serious situation."
dialogues.text: "Whoa, it sounds like a serious situation."

dialogues.jp:
まずは見知らぬ天井と、畳の匂いに覚えがなく
て夢を見ているのかと思った。

だが、馬乗りになって俺を見下ろすさくらを見
て、そこがどこかを思い出す。
dialogues.en:
I thought it was a huggable pillow, but actually it's
Sakura's body.
dialogues.text:
I thought it was a huggable pillow, but actually it's
Sakura's body.

dialogues.jp: 「で、お前はなにやってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: My hands are between her neck and her belly button.
dialogues.text: My hands are between her neck and her belly button.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うさぎさん♪」

リボンを立ててウサ耳を表現しているのか。多
分、このまま流してしまったほうがいいのだろ
う。
dialogues.en:
I don't know how to react. I mean, there's nothing for my
hands to grasp, so it doesn't feel like anything. So I don't
find it particularly exciting or annoying.
dialogues.text:
I don't know how to react. I mean, there's nothing for my
hands to grasp, so it doesn't feel like anything. So I don't
find it particularly exciting or annoying.

dialogues.jp: 「で、俺はなにをしてるんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「わぉ、なんかその表現は凄いね――この状況
　で」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺もそう思う」

抱き枕だと思っていたのはもちろん、さくらそ
のものだった。
dialogues.en: "That's a very difficult question to answer."
dialogues.text: "That's a very difficult question to answer."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「むぎゅぅ〜」

手のやり場に困っていたのだが、さくらがその
まま俺に覆い被さるように抱きついてくる。
dialogues.en:
While I was thinking where I should put my hands, Sakura
flopped over my body to snuggle up with me.
dialogues.text:
While I was thinking where I should put my hands, Sakura
flopped over my body to snuggle up with me.

dialogues.jp:
「ってな！？　普通は嫌がるか離れるかのどっ
　ちかだろうが！！」
dialogues.en: "See! Usually, people try to avoid it or get away from it."
dialogues.text: "See! Usually, people try to avoid it or get away from it."

dialogues.jp:
朝っぱらから、かったるいのに声を上げてしま
う。
dialogues.en: I raise my voice, despite my morning sleepiness.
dialogues.text: I raise my voice, despite my morning sleepiness.

dialogues.jp:
こういう時に限って、音夢か誰かに目撃される
のがオチなのだろうが、現実に｛みとが／見咎｝める者はい
ない。
dialogues.en:
I know Nemu or somebody would usually walk in at times like
this, but fortunately there's nobody else around.
dialogues.text:
I know Nemu or somebody would usually walk in at times like
this, but fortunately there's nobody else around.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃはは、はじめてお兄ちゃんの寝顔見た」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... I saw your sleeping face for the first time."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... I saw your sleeping face for the first time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ハッピーな気分だよ♪」
こいつ、本気で喜んでるのか？
俺の寝顔なんかで。
「……いいから離れろ」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ」

目が覚めてしまえば、あっさりとさくらをどか
すことが出来る。
dialogues.en: Once I wake up, it's easy to get Sakura off of me.
dialogues.text: Once I wake up, it's easy to get Sakura off of me.

dialogues.jp: 「朝、か」

いつのまにか敷かれていた布団からはいずって、
縁側から空を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
I crawl out of my bed, and look up at the sky through the
porch.
dialogues.text:
I crawl out of my bed, and look up at the sky through the
porch.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……思いっきり寝過ごしたな」

さくらと話をしながら、翌日まで寝こけたとい
うことか。
dialogues.en: Talking with Sakura, I slept in until the next day.
dialogues.text: Talking with Sakura, I slept in until the next day.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「全然お話できなかったよ」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、別に時間がないわけじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Well, we still have lots of time for that."
dialogues.text: "Well, we still have lots of time for that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだけど……お兄ちゃんの寝顔が見れたか
　ら、いっか」
dialogues.en:
"I know that, but I'm happy that I could see your sleeping
face."
dialogues.text:
"I know that, but I'm happy that I could see your sleeping
face."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「腹減ったな」
恥ずかしくて、さくらの言葉を聞き流して呟く。
dialogues.en:
I mumble, after pretending to listen to Sakura with
embarrassment.
dialogues.text:
I mumble, after pretending to listen to Sakura with
embarrassment.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、しまった。家にカレーがあったな」
dialogues.en: "Darn! I have curried rice at home."
dialogues.text: "Darn! I have curried rice at home."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……行っちゃやだ」

ぎゅっ、と俺の服の｛すそ／裾｝をさくらが握りこんでい
た。
dialogues.en: Sakura tugged at the edge of my clothes.
dialogues.text: Sakura tugged at the edge of my clothes.

dialogues.jp: 「って、行かねぇよ」

俺を見上げながら、うるうる、とさくらが腰に
しがみつこうとする。
dialogues.en: Gazing up at me, Sakura hangs on to my waist.
dialogues.text: Gazing up at me, Sakura hangs on to my waist.

dialogues.jp:
「信じろ。さすがにカレーよりはお前のほうが
　大事だ」
dialogues.en: "Trust me. You are more important than my curried rice."
dialogues.text: "Trust me. You are more important than my curried rice."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにょ？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「寝かせたほうが美味い」
dialogues.en: "It tastes better if we let it sit anyway."
dialogues.text: "It tastes better if we let it sit anyway."

dialogues.jp:
冗談というか、てっきりさくらが騒ぎ出すと思っ
たのだが。
dialogues.en: It was a joke, and I expected Sakura would react to it.
dialogues.text: It was a joke, and I expected Sakura would react to it.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
ピン――とさくらが指を立てる。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「カレーと書いて幼なじみと説く、その心は？」
dialogues.en: "Why is curry like a childhood friend?"
dialogues.text: "Why is curry like a childhood friend?"

dialogues.jp: ……その心は
◆カレーと幼馴染み◆

目を覚ますと、隣でさくらが寝ていて、しかも
ナイ胸を触ってしまっていたりなんだり……。
dialogues.en:
When I woke up, Sakura was sleeping next to me. I
accidentally touched her flat breasts...
dialogues.text:
When I woke up, Sakura was sleeping next to me. I
accidentally touched her flat breasts...

dialogues.jp:
ごろごろと適当に寝転びながら話をしていると、
「カレーと書いて幼なじみと説く、その心は？」
などと聞かれた。
dialogues.en:
While we were talking lying down, she gave me the question
'Why is curry like a childhood friend?'"
dialogues.text:
While we were talking lying down, she gave me the question
'Why is curry like a childhood friend?'"

choices.en: ○It's a pain in the neck to make.
choices.text: ○It's a pain in the neck to make.
